## Checklist

- [ ] A change that moves an estimate comes with an updated `golden/results.json` (`npm run golden`), and its diff
      looks the way I expect.
- [ ] No question or option id was removed or renamed, or the major version is raised.
- [ ] New sources are added to the question's `sources`.
- [ ] New or changed texts follow the Writing section of CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] `npm test`, `npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck` pass.
